I literally just got it off a half-hearted recommendation - and it was a bit of programming, or so I heard, and I love programming puzzle games.

Well, the gameplay was disappointing since a majority of the gameplay is not programming, but instead is the Flappy Bird-like autorun junk or cluelessly wandering menus - the gameplay turns into one big chunk of padding, even the ending sequence takes too long - the story is yet another plot where the writing is mostly just a bunch of loose ends, and the 'programming' aspect is not a clever bit of puzzle solving but more like pushing a marble around a maze.
